svg.title: Open Source Metro | Living Network | SHARED SYNTHETIC FIXTURE
svg.desc: A 53-week Sunday-to-Saturday GitHub-style event calendar above up to five horizontal repository journeys. Each coloured line is a specific repository. Small stops represent weeks with recorded source events; larger rings show recorded merged pull requests or releases. Thin interchange bars mean only that projects had source events in the same week, not dependencies. Blank calendar dates are unobserved, not confirmed zero GitHub contributions. This image does not claim a complete GitHub contributions history.

g.text: One year. Five project journeys. Every stop has a source.
